Move an entry into .claude-plugin/marketplace.json only when its plugin directory exists and validates — every marketplace `source` must point at a directory containing .claude-plugin/plugin.json (invariant I8). Names/descriptions below are the canonical CP-catalog wording.

planned.name: ai-use-policy-generator
planned.description: Generates a tailored AI use policy for your firm covering client confidentiality, competence obligations, disclosure requirements, and acceptable-use guardrails — aligned to your jurisdiction's ethics rules.

planned.name: consult-prep-brief-generator
planned.description: Turns a prospective client intake form or email thread into a focused consultation brief: key facts, likely claims, jurisdiction notes, and the three questions most worth asking in the first meeting.

planned.name: ai-tool-hygiene-audit
planned.description: Audits your firm's current AI tool usage against bar ethics rules — confidentiality, competence, supervision, and disclosure — and produces a prioritized remediation checklist.
